senses.gloss: m. (אדם) red substance, fleshy substance [cmp. אֲדָמָה, אָדָם; b. h. אֹדֶם rubin].
units: <cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Kilayim 8:3:7">Y. Kil. VIII, 31ᶜ</cite> bot. <he>הא׳ מן האשה</he> from the mother the embryo receives the substance for forming skin, flesh, and blood; opp. <cite ref="L00182"><he>לוֹבֶן</he></cite> white, sticky substance.

<cite ref="Niddah 32b:1">Nidd. 32ᵇ</cite> <he>למעוטי איש מא׳</he> to exempt man from being unclean from a red (blood) discharge, opp. to <cite ref="L00182"><he>לובן</he></cite> white gonorrhoeic discharge.
